item.title: Is Dhurandhar 2 already winning overseas box office race against Toxic? Here’s what trade numbers say
item.description: Is Dhurandhar 2 already leading the overseas box office race against Toxic? Early US trade numbers show Ranveer Singh’s sequel pulling ahead in advance bookings, while Yash’s action drama gears up for expansion. Here’s a detailed look at the latest pre-sales figures.

item.title: Safe and calm Holi 2026 celebrations for families with ADHD children
item.description: Holi can overwhelm children with ADHD due to noise, crowds and sensory triggers. Here are the simple, practical ways to celebrate safely while keeping your child calm and comfortable.

item.title: CBSE Class 10, 12 exams scheduled for March 5, 6 postponed in West Asia amid war; new dates soon
item.description: CBSE has postponed Class 10, 12 board exams scheduled on March 5 and 6, 2026, in the West Asian countries due to the ongoing war. The decision follows a review of the regional situation with revised dates to be announced later. Earlier, the board also postponed the exam for March 2.

item.title: Iran strikes Dubai: Economic fallout & future implications for UAE, global markets
item.description: Iran’s missile strikes on Dubai following US-Israel military action have ignited fears for the UAE economy. Attacks on key infrastructure like Dubai International Airport and AWS data centers threaten billions in losses.

item.title: US-Iran conflict: Esha Gupta returns to India, Yo Yo Honey Singh assures fans of his safety in Dubai
item.description: Amid escalating US-Iran tensions, Bollywood actress Esha Gupta has returned to India after reassuring fans she was safe in Abu Dhabi. Meanwhile, rapper Honey Singh, still in Dubai, confirmed his safety with a studio update. Here’s what celebrities are saying about the evolving situation.

item.title: Pebbles in food turned to giant stones: Almora’s ‘Bhima Patthar’ keeps ancient Mahabharata folklore alive
item.description: In Almora, Uttarakhand, villagers believe giant stones are remnants of pebbles Bhima threw away during exile in the Mahabharata era. Revered as sacred, these stones symbolize faith, heritage, and the region’s cultural identity.

item.title: Narendra Modi sets global record with 30M YouTube subscribers, leaves Bolsonaro and Trump behind
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s YouTube channel has crossed 30 million subscribers, the highest among world leaders. He leads by a wide margin over leaders like Jair Bolsonaro and Donald Trump, highlighting his strong global digital presence.

item.title: GalaxEye’s Drishti OptoSAR satellite is ready for launch
item.description: Bengaluru-based New Space startup GalaxEye has realised its innovative Drishti OptoSAR satellite. The satellite is being shipped to the US for a SpaceX launch.

item.title: BYD reveals Seal 07 EV with 705 km range before international debut
item.description: BYD have revealed the upcoming Seal 07 EV, which has a claimed range of 705 km, making it from 69.07 kWH BY Blade battery pack. Performance figures should look something 240 kW.

item.title: Khamenei’s wife Mansoureh Khojasteh dies after 48 hours in coma following US-Israeli strikes
item.description: She had slipped in coma since Saturday’s strike. Khojasteh, 78, was the only wife of Ali Khamenei. The couple, who got married in 1964, had six children. Khojasteh generally stayed away from public attention.
